reviews.text: Working with Surge Power has been great. Serge and his staff really do a good job taking care of everyone they work with. If you’re motivated and want to work, this is a good place to be. Just be prepared to work hard and keep up with the pace!
reviews.author: New L.

reviews.text: Excellent company to work with. The team was professional, reliable, and did a great job from start to finish. They take pride in their work, and it shows. I would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Eduard S.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Surge Power. Their team was professional, efficient, and completed the job on time. They clearly explained everything and ensured the work met all safety standards. I highly recommend their services!
reviews.author: Alex P.
